title: Co-design of frequency and bandwidth conversion for heterogeneous quantum links
result: Noise-aware co-design of quantum frequency conversion and bandwidth matching; in simulation, median 4.1x higher distillable entanglement at 100 km.

title: Chip-aware QAOA placement on modular quantum devices
result: Kernighan-Lin placement raises noisy QAOA MaxCut approximation ratio by 0.04-0.06 at a 20x coupler error ratio (n=8-12, simulation).

title: XY-mixer vs penalty QAOA: noise crossover
result: Finds the noise level where the gate overhead of a constrained XY mixer cancels its feasibility advantage on densest-k-subgraph.

title: QML advantage benchmarking
result: QAOA vs brute-force MaxCut on graphs of 4 to 12 nodes, tracking approximation ratio and runtime to locate the crossover regime.

title: Hardware-efficient QPU ansatz
result: VQE for the H2 ground state with an Ry/Rz and nearest-neighbour CNOT ansatz matched to QPU topology.

title: Zero-noise extrapolation for error mitigation
result: Unitary folding and Richardson extrapolation recover noise-free expectation values from simulated depolarising noise.

title: Tensor-network many-body ground states
result: From-scratch MPS for the transverse-field Ising model, validated against exact diagonalisation, with entanglement entropy.

title: Trotterized quantum dynamics
result: Suzuki-Trotter simulation of an XY spin chain on gate-based circuits, compared with exact time evolution.

title: QAOA Max-Cut with RL-inspired tuning
result: QAOA Max-Cut in Qiskit whose iterative parameter tuning mirrors RL policy optimisation, with a command-line interface.

title: Quantum-walk influence maximization
result: Continuous-time quantum walk finds influential nodes in scale-free networks via interference, with a linear-threshold spread simulation.

title: Quantum recurrent attention for EV battery state of health
result: MQAttn-QLSTM-VQR: a 988-parameter quantum recurrent attention model compared with a parameter-matched classical twin on three datasets.

title: TIDAL: underwater acoustic network resource allocation
result: Simulation repository for two-timescale, deadline- and Doppler-aware resource allocation in mission-critical underwater acoustic networks (code to follow).

title: Quantum-like fuzzy MAGDM benchmark
result: Empirical benchmarking of quantum-like fuzzy multiattribute group decision making (code to follow).
